comments.text: Exchanges the picture with the second picture: blanks the screen, runs swap_script, sets the background colour, and shows the screen again.

Swap (command $0e, from the command table at $0d74). Shows the picture with the tool label (script $2f6d). Each press exchanges the picture with the second picture. No touch and a long press ends the tool ($1495).
cursor_sprites = $c0: the cursor shows sprites 6 and 7.
Compares A, not X: A is 0 here, so the branch is not taken.
Script: calls $1dd3, then exchanges $6000-$7f3f with $e000, $c000-$c3e7 with $d800, $c3e8-$c7cf with $dc00 and $c7d0 with $dfe8 (op 4 swaps with I/O and ROM off), then calls $1dfe.
